text: In the Terminal, unplugging needs the whole word, so a slip of the keys can't do it. It also ended every session through the box. For a defender, pulling an unknown box cuts off everything it carried. That's the whole tour. Come and find me for the short version.
style: Security lead on Merrin & Sallow's outsourced IT provider (Fenlow Managed IT), in her 40s, warm and practical. Speak with a consistent London and southern English accent throughout — do not shift to any other accent.
